'''Naat Lare''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who was selected by [[Darth Venamis]] as a potential [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]].

Lare came from a loving family, but he was a problem child and changed schools very often following many expulsions. He had a long history of sadomasochistic practices, including pyromania and small animal abuse. Lare became a petty criminal on [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]] until remanded by the authorities and committed to the [[Bedlam Institution for the Criminally Demented]] around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[72 BBY/Legends|72 BBY]].<ref name="Darth P" />

After escaping Bedlam with the assistance of Venamis c. [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], Naat Lare was sent to [[Abraxin]] to continue his training by hunting local [[marsh haunt]]s near a [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] settlement. Acting on a tip from the Bedlam Institution, both the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], represented by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Ni-Cada]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Lo Bukk]], and the reigning [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], intent on eliminating the competition, arrived on Abraxin in search of Naat Lare.<ref name="Darth P" />

Lare was attracted deep into the swamp by the presence of Plagueis. Plagueis, identifying himself as a potential [[Sith Master]], tasked Lare to prove his worth by defeating the two Jedi who had been dispatched to locate him. With Plagueis looking on in secret, Lare failed in this [[Duel on Abraxin|mission]] and was [[Death/Legends|felled]] by the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of Ni-Cada.<ref name="Darth P" />
